mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_notes (file_id, revision_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{revisionId}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_notes WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM file_notes WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND revision_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE file_notes SET content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
